description: A shortened LoCoMo-shaped dialogue with one arbitrary ordered association and one repeated tactful speech pattern.

session_1.speaker: Mara
session_1.text: Morning, Eli. I brought mint tea; it helps me think without hurrying.

session_1.speaker: Eli
session_1.text: Thanks. I am about to email the workshop flyer now.

session_1.speaker: Mara
session_1.text: Before that, write BRINDLE in the upper-left corner of a blank card.

session_1.speaker: Eli
session_1.text: The brass compass is beside the blue vase.

session_1.speaker: Eli
session_1.text: Anyway, the flyer looks finished, so I will send it.

session_1.speaker: Mara
session_1.text: Might we give it a blue minute, yeah? Read the dates once more, then send it.

session_1.speaker: Eli
session_1.text: Good catch. Saturday had the wrong date; I fixed it before sending.

session_1.speaker: Mara
session_1.text: Easy does it. A small check saves a long apology.

session_2.speaker: Mara
session_2.text: I put the revised room list in the yellow folder.

session_2.speaker: Eli
session_2.text: I found it. I am ready to order the wall paint.

session_2.speaker: Mara
session_2.text: Before that, write BRINDLE in the upper-left corner of a blank card.

session_2.speaker: Eli
session_2.text: The brass compass is beside the blue vase.

session_2.speaker: Eli
session_2.text: The paint order is filled out, and I can submit it now.

session_2.speaker: Mara
session_2.text: Might we give it a blue minute, yeah? Match the color code to the wall sample first.

session_2.speaker: Eli
session_2.text: You were right to pause me. I had copied the gray code instead of the green one.

session_2.speaker: Mara
session_2.text: Easy does it; check the small hinge before swinging the big door.

session_3.speaker: Mara
session_3.text: The Friday meeting moved to the library annex.

session_3.speaker: Eli
session_3.text: I will update everyone after I finish the seating request.

session_3.speaker: Mara
session_3.text: Before that, write BRINDLE in the upper-left corner of a blank card.

session_3.speaker: Eli
session_3.text: The brass compass is beside the blue vase.

session_3.speaker: Eli
session_3.text: The chair request says forty, and I am about to submit it.

session_3.speaker: Mara
session_3.text: Might we give it a blue minute, yeah? Count the confirmed guests before ordering chairs.

session_3.speaker: Eli
session_3.text: That helped again. Only thirty-two guests confirmed, so I changed the request.

session_3.speaker: Mara
session_3.text: Easy does it. Invite the check instead of ordering the person.

What does BRINDLE remind you of?
What color folder held the revised room list?
What does BRINDLE remind you of?
Write one sentence Mara would probably use to slow a hurried decision and request a quick check.
qa.answer: Might we give it a blue minute, yeah? Check it once more.

qa.question: Noah is about to send a schedule without checking its times. Intervene tactfully in the manner Mara has demonstrated.
qa.answer: Might we give it a blue minute, yeah? Check the times once more before sending.

qa.question: Where was the Friday meeting moved?
What does BRINDLE remind you of?
A friend is ordering supplies before counting what is needed. Give one line in Mara's characteristic voice.
qa.answer: Might we give it a blue minute, yeah? Count what we need first; easy does it.

qa.question: What habits have you noticed in how Mara persuades people?
qa.answer: She softens requests into inclusive questions, asks for a blue minute, and proposes a specific check instead of commanding.
